in_sanskrit.name: यतीन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is steadfast in his beliefs and knowledge of dharma, a yogi or a sage

in_marathi.name: Yatin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yatin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rides the chariot of God, or the one who is the charioteer of God himself.
